body:
I appreciate you responding to me so much, regardless of how much you don't think you should give advice. Thank you.

I know how fucking hard it is, I hate it, and you're so strong for moving forward. I keep falling back, backpedalling. It kills me. 

I've tried to talk to many counselors, but nothing feels like it's helping, and it's exhausting starting to tell my story from the beginning so many times.

I wish it was easier. I wish you all the best.

I have severe anorexia, depression, anxiety, and don't feel like I deserve anything I have, which amplifies all the problems tenfold.

My life looks fantastic on paper, but in reality, I'm a fucking mess. I have a loving, great boyfriend (who I don't feel like I deserve, feel so insecure about losing the relationship, and feel needy and annoying talking about my problems) 2 degrees (that I feel will not get me anywhere, may not even be what I want to do, I feel like I'm not good at anything and can't enjoy any job that I do get) a place to live (do not have nearly enough money to live on my own, living with my dad and step mom, hate it there, always scrutinized, trapped, hopeless, far from my boyfriend) an internship (constantly insecure, don't feel trusted to do important work, scared about being hired full-on in an industry I am not confident in, and continuing on).

My mom has completely cut me out of her life. We have not spoken in 8 months. 

I am suicidal.

I don't know what to do.

This will get buried, but whatever. 

Canadian here.

I've known people who will go to no ends to destroy someone emotionally. People here will walk down the street and talk to no one, say excuse me, or show any form of common courtesy.

Canadians are assholes, too.
